SELECT 
  c.access_token,
  a.id as chatwoot_account_id,
  a.custom_attributes->'config'->'post_sale' as post_sale,
  c.ml_user_id,
  c.status,
  c.bridge_enabled,
  a.custom_attributes->>'receive_only' as receive_only
FROM meli_credentials c
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = c.account_id
WHERE c.ml_user_id = '{{ $('orders_trigger').item.json.body.user_id }}';

INSERT INTO meli_orders (
  account_id, ml_order_id, ml_buyer_id, buyer_nickname, item_id, item_title, quantity,
  total_amount, currency_id, date_created,
  pack_id, order_status, shipping_mode, message_sent, created_at, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $('get_order_account_details').item.json.chatwoot_account_id }},
  '{{ $('get_order_details').item.json.id }}',
  '{{ $('get_order_details').item.json.buyer?.id }}',
  '{{ $('get_order_details').item.json.buyer?.nickname }}',
  '{{ $('get_order_details').item.json.order_items[0].item?.id }}',
  '{{ $('get_order_details').item.json.order_items[0].item?.title }}',
  {{ $('get_order_details').item.json.order_items[0].quantity ?? 'NULL' }},
  {{ $('get_order_details').item.json.total_amount ?? 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $('get_order_details').item.json.currency_id }}',
  {{ $('get_order_details').item.json.date_created !== null ? "'" + $('get_order_details').item.json.date_created + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $('get_order_details').item.json.pack_id !== null ? "'" + $('get_order_details').item.json.pack_id + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $('get_order_details').item.json.status }}',
  '{{ $('get_order_details').item.json.shipping?.logistic_type }}',
  false,
  NOW(), NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (account_id, ml_order_id) DO NOTHING;
